An orb pauses 5 minutes after the agent stops working or 20 minutes after your last interaction, whichever comes later, and a paused orb costs nothing. Larger orbs use the minute allowance faster. Model tokens can come from linked ChatGPT, Claude or other subscriptions, or from your own API keys (BYOK), with 'No Amp token fees or limits' on Hobby, Individual and Teams (the free-agent announcement makes an exception for Enterprise). Once included agent usage runs out, you can buy paid credits, charged at the provider's API price with no markup for individuals and non-enterprise workspaces. Purchased credits expire twelve months after purchase. Self-hosted orbs are free on Hobby, Individual and Teams. Since October 29, 2026, Enterprise pays 100% of the standard per-minute price for them.
